name: Gnoll Hunter
generous: Mostly use melee attacks, attack undamaged heroes.
deadly: Use ranged attacks to damage multiple targets.

name: Gnoll Packleader
generous: Bark Orders to move Gnolls adjacent to heroes after the gnoll has already attacked.
deadly: Bark Orders to move Gnolls to safety after they've acted, or to give them extra movement needed to chase down heroes hiding behind the frontliners.

name: Gnoll Frenzied One
generous: Target well-armored or undamaged heroes. Have them ignore the Packleader's commands.
deadly: Bloodthirsty and Frenzy can stack, giving Advantage 2.

name: Gnoll Battle Shaman
generous: Focus the Dread dice on 1 well-armored target.
deadly: Whichever dice roll low on Withering Dread, damage unharmed allies. Spread the remaining dice out to make defending unappealing.

name: Briarbane Seedling
generous: Attack while heroes are adjacent. Attack Acidpods when they'll damage other Briarbanes.
deadly: Target Grappled heroes, or Acidpods that are in a good position to explode and hit multiple enemies.

name: Briarbane Acidpod
generous: Grab isolated or well-armored or high DEX heroes.
deadly: Grab heroes near their allies then shoot it with Seedlings for a big explosion! Combo with Tanglers to Pull heroes into a clump.

name: Briarbane Tangler
generous: Separate them from their allies. They're far less deadly without other creatures taking advantage of their Grapple.
deadly: Act first amonsgt monsters to set up advantage on their attacks. Avoid heroes who deal fire or slashing damage.

name: Briarbane Rootbreaker
generous: Target Grappled heroes, likely breaking them free.
deadly: Angle their attacks to push heroes into each other or toward Acidpods.

name: Briarbane Treant
generous: Mostly use Slam, targeting well-armored heroes.
deadly: Use Stomp as often as possible, including against heroes Grappled by allies.

name: Spinning Blades Trap
generous: Use it in a wide area, making it easily avoidable. Or it can shut down temporarily after dealing damage once or twice.
deadly: Use it in a narrow area, forcing heroes to slip past it to fight properly. Throw Oozes at it until the heroes cry!

name: Druid
generous: Use Beastshift to charge into combat aggressively. Keep melee heroes nearby with Hurricane.
deadly: Push heroes into obstacles or hazards with Hurricane. Use Beastshift to strike then escape melee.

name: Spring Golem
generous: Stay away from Entangled foes, preventing you from using Swiftspear on them if they escape.
deadly: Always move toward Entangled foes, so you can use Swiftspear. If you have at least 2 foes Entangled, use Crushing Vines.

name: Duskprowler
generous: Stay near heroes that use large damage dice to attack.
deadly: Focus on attacking heroes with small damage dice (daggers, unarmed strikes, wind spells).

name: Owlbear
generous: Use Fearsome Hoot after you are bloodied.
deadly: Use Fearsome Hoot early, so that Frightened lasts longer.

name: Forest Wolves
generous: Allow one wolf to take most of the damage at the beginning, so that Fearsome Howl goes away quickly. Have the Wolves flee early.
deadly: Move in and out of melee range, so that it takes longer for any single wolf to die. Have the Pack Leader Interpose for wolves, to keep them from dying and fleeing.

name: Dryads
generous: Stay within your home tree, even after it is attacked.
deadly: Immediately teleport to another tree within sight after your bonded tree is attacked. Distract them by attacking from a non-bonded tree.

name: Snake Swarm Horde
generous: Overlap space with a small number of heroes. Clump together, making AOEs do more damage.
deadly: Enter the spaces of as many heroes as possible. Spread out, to put pressure on the whole party and make AOEs less effective.

name: Bug
generous: Focus fire on heroes with high armor or near heroes with strong AoE abilities.
deadly: Multiple small creatures can fit in a single space. Surrounding a hero with 10–20 minions can get deadly FAST (especially if they have low armor or no AoE abilities)!

name: Giant Bug
generous: Stay in melee reach or clump together with other bugs.
deadly: Move out of melee reach after attacking; summon minions in places that block movement and obstruct heroes' plans.

name: Toughrider Bug
generous: Focus fire on heroes with high armor or near heroes with strong AoE abilities.
deadly: When Riding, attacks that miss you damage the Ridden target! Medium armor means these combo well with the Bonfire Bug's Eruption damage, taking no damage from it.

name: Acidshot Bug
generous: Move adjacent to heroes and attack with disadvantage.
deadly: Stay at range (e.g., trees, ceiling of a tunnel) shoot, then move further away.

name: Jacker Bug
generous: Attack first, allowing heroes to easily Defend. Foreshadow the effects of the Toxin (via an NPC or Naturecraft checks).
deadly: Attack with them last, after a hero has already Defended or attack in pairs to get damage through.

name: Bonfire Bug
generous: Allow a hero who kills one to knock it in a direction where it will explode and take out other bugs.
deadly: Skitter toward heroes who are clumped closely together, or start a chain reaction with other bonfire bugs!

name: Vicejaw Bug
generous: Let go of heroes after 1 round in order to attack another.
deadly: Aim for weak backline heroes. Isolate them from their allies (remember: Grappled targets are attacked w/advantage).

name: Thrum Bug
generous: Aim for only 1 or 2 heroes, prioritizing heroes with high WIL saves (Shepherd, Stormshifter, Songweaver, Psion)
deadly: Hit as many heroes as possible, prioritizing heroes with poor WIL saves (The Cheat, Shadowmancer, Artificer).

name: Spit Bug
generous: Use Acid Spit when in melee (rolling with disadvantage).
deadly: Climb to a high spot (ceiling of a cave or tree branch), Restrain as many heroes as possible to use up their actions and grant your allies advantage.

name: Maneater Bug
generous: Quick Strike a hero who already got a low Initiative roll.
deadly: Quick Strike 2 different heroes with a higher Initiative to really tilt the odds in your favor.

name: Rhino Bug
generous: Target a single hero (and some other bugs) with Charge.
deadly: Combo with Vicejaws, Maneaters, and Spitbugs to line up many heroes for a powerful Charge.

name: Ballistic Bug
generous: Waste the attack on few heroes or include some allied bugs.
deadly: Combo with Grappling bugs to move heroes into the blast zone, making it harder for them to escape while Poisoned!

name: Oozes
generous: Oozes often move very slowly or can easily become distracted by detritus in the dungeon.
deadly: Oozes can be particularly nasty when falling from above, against heroes with slashing attacks, pit traps, or slashing traps.

name: Cockatrice
generous: Attack different heroes, especially ones with high Defense.
deadly: Focus a single, low Defense, hero.

name: Lithogallus the Impeccable
generous: Use heelspur as much as possible.
deadly: Use Stony Peck as much as possible.

name: Carrion Worm
generous: Stay at range.
deadly: Engage in melee to hit multiple heroes with your aura.

name: Stirges
generous: Delatch after a round or two.
deadly: Attack heroes with high Defense, combos well with creatures who Poison, Blind, or otherwise give additional Disadvantage.

name: Mummy
generous: Target high-defense or already Dazed heroes. If guarding a tomb, it will not pursue the heroes if they escape.
deadly: Target Grappled heroes and ones not already Dazed.

name: Mummy Lord
generous: Your Scarab Swarms act next round, and attack heroes you aren't attacking.
deadly: Your Scarab Swarms act immediately upon being summoned, focus Slam on Grappled heroes.

name: Snakeman Minion
deadly: Unique for minions, Snakemen can strike from a distance, us it to your advantage to stay away from danger!

name: Shadow Dragon
generous: Leave your Umbral Minions near heroes who are dying or low on actions. When summoned, make them wait until the end of the round to act.
deadly: Protect your Umbral Minions preciously. Make the heroes work to regain their actions back!

name: Lizardfolk Reedstalker
generous: Attack already Poisoned heroes, act after Scalebreakers
deadly: Attacks from Invisible can't be Defended or Interposed!

name: Lizardfolk Scalebreaker
generous: Act first and target non-Hampered heroes
deadly: Act last and prioritize Hampered heroes.

name: Lizardfolk Hunter
generous: "Forget" to use your net; attack from up close.
deadly: Net is wet/reinforced (unaffected by fire/slashing damage). Use Muck to get at maximum Range before attacking.

name: Lizardfolk Broodguard
generous: Interpose against crits or other attacks good VS heavy armor. Hold position near other lizardfolk and forego attacking.
deadly: Protect high-damage allies like Hunters. Interpose against attacks that are less effective against Heavy armor.

name: Lizardfolk Shaman
generous: Warn that the shaman isn't being protected. "It's almost as if she wants to sacrifice herself."
deadly: Charge forward, egg the heroes into attacking the shaman.

name: Lizardfolk Greatscale
generous: Tailswipe a small number of heroes. Crush a non-Prone target.
deadly: Act last, combo with Scalebreaker and Raptor for big damage.

name: Swamp Raptor
generous: Spread the Raptors and allies out, attacking different targets.
deadly: Use their speed to attack isolated heroes in packs. They'll gain advantage from Pack Tactics, Prone, AND Restrained!

name: Hydra
generous: Spread the attacks out, or attack a Dying hero with all heads, it only counts as a single attack and is not likely to crit!
deadly: Attack a single hero for devastating damage!

name: Bogleech
generous: Leap from the water, revealing yourself, and chase targets onto dry land.
deadly: Remain hidden underwater until a hero is distracted or weakened.

name: Diretoad
generous: Gorge yourself! Fill up with heroes hitting for 2x damage.
deadly: Attack from max reach, and hop away with your prize!

name: Crabman
generous: Start a conversation! Crabmen will believe almost anything they are told. Give the heroes an opening to trick the Crabmen into a truce or surrender.
deadly: Focus weaker targets with the Crabman's friends while melee fighters are grappled.

name: Crabman Brute
generous: Start an argument about which Crabman is strongest! Alternatively, push a grappled hero out of a Crabman's grasp.
deadly: Push heroes into deep water, sharp stones, or other hazards.

name: Huskwalker
generous: Attack any target that is closest. Move on to other targets after knocking Prone, or wander aimlessly is a undead haze.
deadly: Crabmen can dog-pile a hero knocked prone by a Huskwalker, keeping them pinned with Grapple.

name: Croakoa Darter
deadly: Excellent when combined with Writhing Baloons

name: Croakoa Brute
generous: Instead of using Squish, Leap Squash from hero to hero.
deadly: Target Weak heroes to Leap Squash then Squish.

name: Croakoa Hunter
deadly: Jump away with Swallowed heroes, near allies or tadpoles.

name: Croakoa Royal Defender
generous: Use Protect the Brood minimally.
deadly: If undamaged this round, use Darters to make you deal additional damage.

name: Croakoa Brood Queen
generous: Telegraph that she BADLY wants to get next to a hero to roll over them.
deadly: Use Poisonous Spit to encourage heroes to approach, then use Crushing Roll to restrain.

name: Writhing Balloons
generous: Winds can shift, directing the Balloon in a different direction. Heroes can kick it back towards enemies. "Waste" a powerful attack popping a balloon.
deadly: Float them near a hero using AoE attacks.

name: Wyvern
deadly: Spread the Poison out, use claws to bait out Defend, then use stinger!

name: Harpy Matriarch
generous: Harpies need to have heroes separated enough to attack effectively.
deadly: Lure heroes off a cliff >:D

name: Storm Giant
generous: Storm Giants may not deal lethal Wounds to an honorable heroes who yield to them as supreme.
deadly: Thunder Stride whenever you can damage 3 or more heroes with it to make them split up. Use Lightning Spear
